verdict.rationale: DeepInfra documents OpenAI SDK-compatible base_url swap and tool_calling support, which enables many agent frameworks (LangChain, AutoGPT-style tools) that support OpenAI-compatible endpoints, but there are no first-party guides specifically for coding agents (e.g., Cursor, Continue, Aider) or agent frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen) by name, and openapi/llms.txt probes return 404s indicating no machine-readable spec for agent tooling discovery. missing for 10: named integration guides for specific coding agents/agent frameworks, working openapi.json/llms.txt for agent auto-discovery, independent confirmation of agent-framework compatibility.
